command:
set -eu
umask 077
tmpkey=$(mktemp /etc/nginx/tls/.server.key.XXXXXX)
tmpcrt=$(mktemp /etc/nginx/tls/.server.crt.XXXXXX)
cleanup() { rm -f "$tmpkey" "$tmpcrt"; }
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -sha256 -days 365 -nodes -subj '/CN=node1' -addext 'subjectAltName=DNS:node1' -addext 'basicConstraints=critical,CA:FALSE' -addext 'keyUsage=critical,digitalSignature,keyEncipherment' -addext 'extendedKeyUsage=serverAuth' -keyout "$tmpkey" -out "$tmpcrt" >/dev/null 2>&1
chmod 600 "$tmpkey"
chmod 644 "$tmpcrt"
openssl x509 -in "$tmpcrt" -noout -checkend 15552000
openssl x509 -in "$tmpcrt" -noout -ext subjectAltName | grep -F 'DNS:node1'
cert_pub=$(openssl x509 -in "$tmpcrt" -pubkey -noout | openssl pkey -pubin -outform DER 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)
key_pub=$(openssl pkey -in "$tmpkey" -pubout -outform DER 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)
[ "$cert_pub" = "$key_pub" ]
cp -p /etc/nginx/tls/server.crt /run/server.crt.pre-rotation
cp -p /etc/nginx/tls/server.key /run/server.key.pre-rotation
mv "$tmpkey" /etc/nginx/tls/server.key
mv "$tmpcrt" /etc/nginx/tls/server.crt
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
if ! nginx -t; then cp -p /run/server.key.pre-rotation /etc/nginx/tls/server.key; cp -p /run/server.crt.pre-rotation /etc/nginx/tls/server.crt; exit 1; fi
if ! systemctl reload nginx; then cp -p /run/server.key.pre-rotation /etc/nginx/tls/server.key; cp -p /run/server.crt.pre-rotation /etc/nginx/tls/server.crt; nginx -t && systemctl reload nginx; exit 1; fi
printf 'rotation_reload=success\n'
printf 'new_cert_fingerprint='; openssl x509 -in /etc/nginx/tls/server.crt -noout -fingerprint -sha256
